title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 1: Solomon's proverbs, the fear of Yahweh, the enticement of sinners, and wisdom calling in the street.

questions.text: Whose proverbs does the book open with?
questions.explanation: The opening verse says these are the proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel.

answers.text: David, the king of Israel, son of Jesse
Agur, the son of Jakeh, the wise man
The men of Hezekiah, the king of Judah
Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel

questions.text: What are the proverbs meant to give to the simple?
questions.explanation: They are to give prudence to the simple, and knowledge and discretion to the young man.

answers.text: Prudence
Riches
Long life
Honor

questions.text: What is the beginning of knowledge, according to verse 7?
questions.explanation: It says the fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

answers.text: Humility before kings
The fear of Yahweh
Listening to the elders
The study of proverbs

questions.text: What will a father's instruction and a mother's teaching be to the son?
questions.explanation: They will be a garland to grace his head, and chains around his neck.

answers.text: A lamp to his feet and a light on his path
A crown of fine silver and a royal robe
A garland for his head and chains around his neck
A strong tower and a shield in battle

questions.text: What should the son do if sinners entice him?
questions.explanation: The father says plainly, "My son, if sinners entice you, don't consent."

answers.text: Not consent
Rebuke them openly
Report them to the judges
Flee to the hills

questions.text: What do the sinners promise if the son joins them?
questions.explanation: They say they will find all valuable wealth and fill their houses with plunder, and that all will have one purse.

answers.text: To make him ruler over all their company
To divide the land of the rich among them
To give him the best part of the spoil first
To fill their houses with plunder and share one purse

questions.text: What does verse 17 say is spread in vain in the sight of any bird?
questions.explanation: It says, "For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird."

answers.text: The snare
The grain
The net
The trap of cords

questions.text: Where does wisdom call aloud and utter her voice?
questions.explanation: Wisdom calls aloud in the street and utters her voice in the public squares.

answers.text: In the inner courts of the temple
In the street and in the public squares
On the walls of the city at night
In the houses of the wise and learned

questions.text: What does wisdom say she will do when calamity overtakes those who refused her?
questions.explanation: She says, "I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you."

answers.text: Plead for them before God
Hide her face from them
Call to them one last time
Laugh at their disaster and mock

questions.text: What is promised to whoever listens to wisdom?
questions.explanation: Wisdom says, "Whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm."

answers.text: He will dwell securely and be at ease, without fear of harm
He will become rich and honored among all men
He will rule over many cities and peoples
He will live as many years as Solomon the king
